content:
Parallel3+ is an update to electrafa's Parallel III router module. I have implemented a catch function to the knobs to prevent values jumping around wildly which makes the mix page with the level meters way more usable. I am probably going to add this functionality to his EQs. The other aspect is there are now mutes for each chain which can be toggled with the bottom C, D, and E keys when holding aux. 
There are some bugs however. If you quickly throw the knob to a vastly different position, it will have to be re-caught. If you haven't used the mix page in a while after messing with other modules, I recommend using the output on the gain pages with the higher F#, G#, and A#.
